content:
[Intro]
[A#5]
I will seize the
day when I
have no roles left to play
I will
seize the day

[Verse 1]
[A#5]Illusions of clari-
ty abound
Out of body exa-
mination
The eyes meeting, inter-
locking
Mirrors ref-
lecting evermore

[Pre - Chorus]
[A#5]Contorted crea-
tures
Apparitions of
haunting association
Claiming unity
and connection
Fragments of a once pris-
tine creation

[Chorus]
[A#5]Silence the solemn
shades
A shadow's shadow
under
the light
of scruti -
ny
Is there
no hope
of oblivion?

[Bridge 1]
[A#5]Introverted sear-
ching
Will there be peace?
Will there be peace?

[Verse 2]
[A#5]Will these bani-
shed masks haunt my dreams?
A bitter shell unnoticed in the
masquerade
This visage
is a façade
of your crea
tion
These acts I
shall carry out
till I
have no
faces
to discard
I must augment myself

[Bridge 2]
[A#5]
I

[Interlude]
[A#5]
will seize the day
when I have
no roles left to play

[Outro]
[A#5]Falsifying con-
nection
Repetition
of contact
An endless
cycle that I
find no worth
in
Bathe me in delusions of self
Awash, drowning
in your expecta
tions
I just wish to aban-
don the
lie
I will seize the
day when I have
no roles left to play
The first
day of
truth
The fi-
nal
day
of ex-
istence
title: The Fabrication
tuning: E B E A D G B E
